_comment: HomeKey-ESP32 configuration template for August Smart Lock Gen 2 mod
_note: This is a reference template. Actual configuration is done via the web portal at http://192.168.4.1

nfc._comment: SPI mode required for HomeKey. I2C will NOT work.

motor._comment: DRV8833 module H-bridge control pins. PWM at 20kHz.

accelerometer._comment: LIS3DH module on I2C bus for lock position feedback

threshold_locked._comment: TODO: Calibrate these values with actual lock

threshold_unlocked._comment: TODO: Calibrate these values with actual lock

leds._comment: WS2812B addressable LED ring for lock status indication
